basic_profile.bio: Avid football fan and lifelong supporter of Blackburn Rovers, living in Blackburn, UK. I work as a mechanical engineer and have a keen interest in music production in my spare time. I'm married to my high school sweetheart, and we have two cats. My online presence peaks during the evenings, especially on match days when I enjoy live discussions. I'm also a regular at the local pub quiz.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of football, particularly the Championship league, acquired through years of following the sport, attending matches, and participating in local fan clubs. Additionally, self-taught in music production and sound engineering, thanks to countless hours spent experimenting with software and collaborating with online communities.
